capabilities: show a reading progress bar with chapter notches and a completion glow
navigate long notes via an edge heading minimap, heading breadcrumb, and read marks
resume reading positions and queue in-progress notes in a reading tray
dim non-active sections or paragraphs and anchor the typing line with typewriter scrolling
track and export per-note and per-day reading time with streaks and a heatmap
disambiguation: Not a theme itself; it is a plugin of JavaScript-driven reading and writing features designed to pair with the MuYun CSS theme.
extras: Works with any theme via standard CSS variables, though visually tuned for MuYun; all data stays local in data.json with no network access or telemetry; mobile is installable but status-bar features are desktop-oriented and mobile behavior is not extensively tested.
intentEvidence: the companion plugin of the MuYun theme
motivation: The author built it to add what the MuYun theme, being pure CSS, could not do: "MuYun Companion adds what a pure-CSS theme cannot do: a suite of reading & writing aids".
problem: Obsidian has no built-in reading-position tracking, document minimap, per-note reading-time statistics, or long-text focus aids, and a pure-CSS theme cannot add these behaviors.

relations.evidence: It was designed alongside the MuYun theme and looks best with it
install it from the community directory — Settings → Community plugins → Browse → search "Style Settings"

summary: Companion plugin for the MuYun theme that adds reading progress, edge minimap, breadcrumbs, resume-reading, reading stats, and writing focus aids.
